name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.66 / build 67 adds the support welcome/request flow, verified first-name or anonymous staff connection, Helpful/Not helpful feedback, explicit ending, read-only Chats history and mobile continuation. Mobile conversations remain saved across logout/app exit. Website close/refresh ends its guest session with a heartbeat timeout fallback; the loading-only pane locks the page behind Chat with Us. Per-patient unread indicators and Human Chat notification routing are included. Matching desktop/backend sources include limited first-session compatibility for earlier clients without reopening ended chats. The Help Bot transcript and booking details are not automatically shared. Physical-phone installation and notification delivery are not verified. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval.
